description: vu1n Renovate policy, copied from hyperstitch/.github:renovate-preset. Pin Actions and images, refresh digests, surface CVEs, and gate every update behind a minimum release age so a poisoned release has time to be yanked first. Consume with { "extends": ["github>vu1n/renovate-config"] }.

lockFileMaintenance.description: Off: it refreshes non-vulnerable transitive deps and the package manager's resolution skips the release-age gate.

packageRules.description: Routine version bumps are off; pinning, digest refresh and CVEs are what earned their keep in hyperstitch's triage. The dashboard still lists every available update. Re-enable per repo with a matchUpdateTypes rule setting enabled:true.
Digest refresh for a tag we already track stays on: it is how base-image security patches reach us.
Group container base-image digest bumps so they review as a unit.
Majors get extra age and a review label when a repo re-enables them.

vulnerabilityAlerts.description: A confirmed GHSA/OSV advisory opens a PR off-schedule, after 3 days so a poisoned fix has a beat to be caught. enabled:true overrides the rule that turns major/minor/patch off.
